title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Exodus 14: Pharaoh's pursuit and Israel's crossing of the sea on dry ground.

questions.text: Where did Yahweh tell Israel to turn back and encamp?
questions.explanation: They were to encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon.

answers.text: At Marah, beside the bitter waters
At Elim, among the springs and the palm trees
At Succoth, on the road from Rameses
Before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea

questions.text: What did Yahweh say Pharaoh would say about the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh would say: 'They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.'

answers.text: They have gone to serve their God and will soon return
They are entangled in the land; the wilderness has shut them in
They are far too many for my army to fight
They have escaped beyond the borders of my land

questions.text: How many chosen chariots did Pharaoh take with him?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

answers.text: Six hundred
Three hundred
One thousand
Seventy

questions.text: What did the frightened Israelites say to Moses?
questions.explanation: They asked: 'Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness?'

answers.text: Why did you not bring more food and water for the way?
Why did you not let us take our flocks and herds along?
Were there no graves in Egypt, that you brought us here to die?
Why have you led us toward the mountain of God instead?

questions.text: What did Moses tell the people to do?
questions.explanation: Moses said: 'Don't be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh,' for Yahweh would fight for them.

answers.text: Run to the hills and hide
Stand still and see the salvation of Yahweh
Take up your swords and fight
Go back to Egypt and ask for mercy

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Moses to lift up before stretching out his hand over the sea?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: 'Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it.'

answers.text: His sword
A bronze serpent
A trumpet
His rod

questions.text: What moved from before the camp of Israel and went behind them?
questions.explanation: The angel of God who went before the camp moved behind them, and the pillar of cloud also moved and stood behind them.

answers.text: The angel of God and the pillar of cloud
Aaron and the elders of Israel
The priests and the Levites
Joshua and the chosen soldiers

questions.text: How did Yahweh make the sea go back?
questions.explanation: Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land.

answers.text: By a great earthquake
By a west wind at noon
By a strong east wind all night
By fire from heaven

questions.text: What did Yahweh take off the Egyptians' chariots?
questions.explanation: Yahweh took off their chariot wheels, so that they drove them heavily.

answers.text: Their wheels
Their horses
Their banners
Their armor plates

questions.text: In whom did the people believe after seeing the great work Yahweh did?
questions.explanation: The people feared Yahweh, and they believed in Yahweh and in his servant Moses.

answers.text: In Aaron and his sister Miriam
In Yahweh and in his servant Moses
In the gods of the land of Egypt
In the strength of their army
